records.title: FPGA-Based Sparse Matrix Multiplication Accelerators: From State-of-the-Art to Future Opportunities
records.reason: ACM publisher full text was not accessible in this session. Available metadata identifies a survey of FPGA sparse-matrix multiplication, related to the FlightLLM accelerator hardware family, but its transformer/LLM applicability could not be checked in the primary text.

records.title: End-to-End Neural Speaker Diarization with an Iterative Refinement of Non-Autoregressive Attention-based Attractors
records.reason: The paper proposes iterative refinement of non-autoregressive attention-based attractors for end-to-end speaker diarization. It is a task-specific speech system; the body presents diarization quality rather than a general language-model inference optimization, so retain only as a weak NAR lineage connection.

records.title: Double Entendre: Robust Audio-Based AI-Generated Lyrics Detection via Multi-View Fusion
records.reason: Double Entendre evaluates audio/lyrics fusion for detecting AI-generated lyrics. It is an application-specific detection model and does not investigate inference efficiency.

records.title: 100-LongBench: Are de facto Long-Context Benchmarks Literally Evaluating Long-Context Ability?
records.reason: 100-LongBench proposes a length-controllable benchmark/metric that separates base model ability from long-context ability. It evaluates long-context enhancement methods, including memory-oriented work, but contributes evaluation rather than an inference optimization; useful as a measurement source, not direct method.

records.title: Neural Genetic Search in Discrete Spaces
records.reason: Neural Genetic Search develops optimization/search algorithms in discrete spaces; the studied contribution is generic search methodology without a demonstrated LLM inference-efficiency application.
